Image/video with text and display typography elements
Accessibility and agent-friendliness PDF report with embedded screenshots
Service binding and URL/token backend proxy
Live local preview and theme switching
Local browser search across Markdown posts
Markdown syntax verification and responsive post screenshots
npm theme installation and blank theme scaffolds
PDF-only audit output and temporary screenshot capture

releaseHistory.notes: Introduced row-first editable pages, shared theme components, plugin and backend guidance, live preview, and visual audit reports.
Improved mobile layouts, added local article search and a compact language menu, verified the bilingual Markdown guide, and made the report cover posts with accessible PDF reading structure.

Published EdgePress for npm installation, added npm theme installation and blank theme packages, documented GitHub and Cloudflare Workers Builds deployment, and added a Cloudflare one-click deployment button.

Keep audit output as a single accessible PDF with embedded screenshots, remove the templates directory and package archive, document Workers Builds initialization troubleshooting, and pin the Wrangler compatibility date to the first of the month.
